provenance.l: Beresheet — an IMU fault and the command sent to fix it shut the main engine off at ~14 km; the restart came too late; last telemetry at ~150 m and ~500 km/h (139 m/s); impact 19:23 UTC 11 Apr 2019. No descent timeline found: the model starts at 2.5 km with the engine nearly dry, to end at the reported impact speed

Beresheet (docs/wip/2026-11-23-lunar-landings-record.md): an IMU fault from about 14 km; the main engine cut at about 10 km and restarted too late; impact at about 139 m/s, contact lost about 150 m up. This profile starts at 2.5 km, so the cut and the late restart are not drawn: the plume is shown going out at 2.4 km (an estimate) and the fall is the recorded impact
